page.layout: One printed page, single column of dictionary entries; running head centred at top; page number at top left. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: Lucanica] Lucanicus botulus. Lucanica hira, Isid. Meurs. Botulus. Botellus, Mart. Farcimen, Varr.
Lucere] Collucere. Splendere. Fulgere, Cic. Claret candidum lumen, Enn. Internitet cœli fulgor, Curt. Interlucet, Lucan.
Lucerna] Lychnus, Cic. Lychnuchi pensiles, Lavin. Lumen, Plin. Noctiluca, Varr.
Lucescit] Lucifcit, Ter. Dilucescit, Cic. Diluculat, Gell. Diluculascit, Plaut. Promicat lux, Amm. Vid. Diluculum.
Lucifer] Stella Veneris, vid. Venus, Cic. Phosphorus, Mart. Iubar, Apul. Fest.
Lucius] Lupus fluvialis, Col. Fluviatilis, Gesn. Caudā placens, Plin.
Lucrari] Lucrifacere, Mart. Lucrifit aliquid. Facere rem meliorem, Cic. Facere lucrum, quæstum, frugem. Compendifacere, Plaut. Rem facere. In lucro deputare, Ter. Facere operæ alicujus pretium, Liv.
Lucrosus] Lucrosa eloquentia, Tac. Lucrosissimum aliquid, Plin. Quæstuosum damnum, Cic. In lucro est, Ovid. Lucri est aliquid, Ter. Lucro est, Plaut. Compendiosus, Col. Mancipium quæstuarium, Ulp.
Lucrum] Lucellum. Quæstus & compendium. Quæsticulus. Accessio, Cic.
Lucrum iniquum] Dispendio æquale, malum lucrum.
Lucro inhiare] Quæstui habere. Conferre in quæstum. Quæstum in aliquâ re facere, Cic. Præmiari, Suet.
Luctari] Colluctari cum aliquo, Plin. Confictari doloribus, Cels. Deluctari. Depugnare cum animo suo, Plaut. Certare secum, Plin. Iuv. Obluctari, Col. Illuctari, Stat.
Luctatio] Lucta, Sipont. Colluctatio, Col. Luctatus, Plin. Luctamen, Virg. Certamen cum aliquo. Certatio, Cic. Certatus, Stat. Confluctatio, Gell.
Luctator] Palæstrita. Valet viribus ad certandum Athleta, Cic. Palæstricus, Quint. Arenarius, Iul.cap. Gymnasiarchus,

page.notes: Catchword-like word "chus," at right foot is the continuation of Gymnasiarchus; kept as printed in the last line. Some words in the scan are faint (e.g. "Confictari", "Confluctatio") and may be misread.
